filing_fee_notes: Regular processing is 50; expedited processing totals 85. The Commission's FAQ quotes 85 for online formation.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a statutory agent with an Arizona physical address. An individual must reside in Arizona and be at least 18; an eligible business must be authorized in Arizona. The agent must accept appointment.
expedite_options: The LLC fee schedule lists expedited Articles of Organization at 85 total and expedited name reservation at 45 total.
publication_requirement: Newspaper publication or Commission database posting depends on location. Follow the Commission's approval letter stating whether newspaper publication is required.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a statutory agent. Follow any publication instructions in the approval letter.
common_mistake: Assuming approval means no publication step remains.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. No LLC annual report; report name, deadline and filing URL are not applicable. Standard processing time, franchise/privilege tax and mandatory operating-agreement status were not confirmed and are null. Publication timing and county exceptions were not independently confirmed.
